paragraphs: R. Chanina of Sura on the Euphrates. Rashi explains that this was another Sura. “Student of R. Chiyya bar Abba”—I do not know the basis. Bava Metzia 61b: Ravina visited Sura on the Euphrates. Rav Chanina of Sura on the Euphrates said to Ravina, “The Exodus from Egypt, etc.” Rashi explains: Sura on the Euphrates, situated on the River Euphrates, is not the unqualified Sura. See Rav Chaviva of Sura on the Euphrates above, who said to Ravina; perhaps they are one person.
